sql: SELECT o.k,(SELECT SUM(q.v) FROM (SELECT i.v FROM ordinary i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.v=20 UNION ALL SELECT j.v FROM ordinary j WHERE j.k=o.k AND j.v=30) q) AS r FROM VALUES (0),(1),(2) o(k) ORDER BY o.k
SELECT o.id,o.k,(SELECT SUM(q.v) FROM (SELECT i.v FROM bag_inner i WHERE i.k=o.k UNION ALL SELECT j.v FROM bag_inner j WHERE j.k=o.k) q) AS r FROM outer_keys o ORDER BY o.id
SELECT o.k,(SELECT SUM(q.v) FROM (SELECT i.v FROM bag_inner i WHERE i.k=o.k UNION ALL SELECT j.v FROM bag_inner j WHERE j.k=o.k) q) AS r FROM (SELECT k FROM outer_keys) o ORDER BY o.k

SELECT o.id,(SELECT SUM(q.key*100+q.v) FROM (SELECT i.k AS key,i.v AS v FROM bag_inner i WHERE i.k=o.k UNION ALL SELECT j.v AS other_key,j.k AS other_value FROM ordinary j WHERE j.k=o.k) q) AS r FROM outer_keys o ORDER BY o.id

SELECT o.id,(SELECT MAX(d.s) FROM (SELECT q.v,SUM(q.v) AS s FROM (SELECT i.v FROM bag_inner i WHERE i.k=o.k UNION ALL SELECT j.v FROM bag_inner j WHERE j.k=o.k) q GROUP BY q.v) d) AS r FROM outer_keys o ORDER BY o.id

SELECT o.id,(SELECT SUM(d.v) FROM (SELECT q.v FROM (SELECT i.v FROM bag_inner i WHERE i.k=o.k UNION ALL SELECT j.v FROM bag_inner j WHERE j.k=o.k) q ORDER BY q.v DESC LIMIT 2) d) AS r FROM outer_keys o ORDER BY o.id
